front: Text or question shown on the front of the card
back: The answer, shown when the card is flipped
hint: Optional. A short nudge shown on the front if the learner is stuck
info: Optional. Shown after you answer (right or wrong), explaining why the answer is what it is (etymology, a naming rule, a mnemonic)

front: You can delete the image, hint, and info fields if you don't need them
